name: eBay Graphics/Video Cards category, used condition, datacenter accelerators (A100/H100 search)
notes: Live eBay SRP capture (LH_ItemCondition=3000 = Used/Pre-Owned + For-parts, _sacat=27386 = Graphics/Video Cards), read 2026-10-03 via a headless browser after plain curl was served HTTP 403 'SORRY'. Condition facet counts on the A100 80GB query: New 43, Open box 6, Certified refurbished 1, Very Good Refurbished 1, Used 27, For parts or not working 8. Price buckets: under $15,000 / $15,000-$35,000 / over $35,000. Individual Pre-Owned asking prices are recorded in the supply records; they are ASK prices on one-off listings, not completed-sale prices, so treat them as ceilings. Sellers in this niche are specialist IT-hardware resellers (Core 4 Solutions IT Hardware, Sunnking Sustainable Solutions) whose titles consistently carry OEM part numbers (699-2G506-xxxx, 900-21001-xxxx), 'Tested Working' / 'Working Pull' language, and explicit 'Requires Compliance Approval' clauses on SXM parts.
